subject: AWS Marketplace operational checklist + field scripting for ACME offer
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Nath an Park <nathan.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace operational checklist + field scripting for ACME offer

Sean — thanks for the call this morning. We've got internal deadlines to meet for the Private Offer and AMI mapping before our pre-launch briefing on 5/20. Can your team confirm the following by EOD Monday?

- Finalized SKU visibility mapping (which SKUs show by region/tenant)
- Field-ready playbook (1 pager + call script) for our sales reps
- Any hard claims we need legal sign-off on (trial limits, SLAs)

I'll attach our AMI export for reference. Ping me if you need a quick review session.

Best,
Elena
Director, Cloud Partnerships
ACME Analytics

Attachments: acme_ami_mapping.csv (CSV)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace operational checklist + field scripting for ACME offer

Thanks Elena — we can hit that. Quick plan and owners below. I'm copying the team who will own each item.

1) SKU visibility mapping — Olga will reconcile ACME's AMI/SKU export to our marketplace SKU mapping and confirm region-level visibility. (owner: olga_petrov)
2) Field playbook + scripting — Kimberly will produce a short sales playbook (1 pager) and 3 call scripts: discovery, demo request, and close-with-private-offer. (owner: kimberly_park)
3) Legal claim triage — Marissa will surface anything that looks like a trust/uptime claim that requires legal or security sign-off. (owner: marissa_cole)

I'll attach our operational checklist draft and a field-playbook template to accelerate review. Can everyone aim for a first pass by Monday 5/10 so Elena can review before 5/12?

Thanks,
Sean
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_aws_operational_checklist_v1.xlsx; field_scripting_playbook_template.docx
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace operational checklist + field scripting for ACME offer

Elena / Sean — dug into the AMI mapping overnight. Quick notes:

- ACME provided 18 AMIs; 12 map cleanly to our standard SKUs. 6 have nonstandard tagging (region:key-value mismatches) — I've flagged those in the attached CSV.
- Visibility: we can publish the 12 immediately to the us-east-1 and us-west-2 marketplaces. The remaining 6 need tag fixes or account entitlement updates (shouldn't block Private Offer, but public listing will be limited per region).
- Ops ask: can ACME run a tagging sweep or provide AMI IDs with the proper "redwood-sku" tag by Friday 5/14? That will allow us to publish everywhere before your internal briefing.

I'll update the checklist with action items and ETA for the entitlement fixes.

Cheers,
Olga
Senior Marketplace Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_ami_mapping_reconciled.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace operational checklist + field scripting for ACME offer

Elena — attaching the draft playbook and three scripts. High-level:

- One-pager covers elevator pitch, target personas, trial eligibility, and co-sell asks (how field should engage AWS/GSI).
- Scripts: discovery (qualifying questions focused on inferencing latency and cost-per-token), demo-request (what to ask Ops to provision for trial), and close-with-private-offer (pricing anchors + trial-to-paid steps).

A few open questions for ACME:
- Do you want us to include AWS-specific procurement language in the close script (e.g., who to loop for Private Offers)?
- Any field examples or customer stories we should include? A one-liner or metric helps the pitch.

Please review the attached PDF and suggest edits. I can hop on a 20-minute call if you prefer to iterate live.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior GTM Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: field_scripting_playbook_v2.pdf
From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Nathan Park <nathan.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace operational checklist + field scripting for ACME offer

Appreciate the fast turnaround — the materials look strong. Quick responses inline: 

- Tag sweep: we can run it. I'll have DevOps push corrected tags for the six AMIs by EOD Friday (5/14).
- Procurement language: yes, please include an AWS Private Offer checklist in the close script (contacts and expected timelines).
- Customer proof: we'll add a one-liner about a 30% inference-cost reduction for SignalGen pilot — I'll send the exact wording by tomorrow.

Next steps per our agreement:
- Redwood: finalize the operational checklist with Olga's AMI reconciliation notes and publish updated board for ACME by 5/14.
- Kimberly: finalize playbook + add AWS Private Offer steps by 5/14.
- Marissa: run quick legal scan on any uptime/availability phrasing by 5/14.

If we stay on this cadence, we should be ready for your pre-launch briefing on 5/20. Thanks everyone — looking forward to the co-sell kickoff.

Best,
Elena
Director, Cloud Partnerships
ACME Analytics

Attachment references: will upload ACME one-liner and confirm AMI tag sweep results
